text:
maria_p: Quick sync — need to align driver/CUDA/ROCm pin + hotfix lifecycle with NV partner and marketplace teams. Can folks confirm availability for a 30m call tomorrow?

alex_r: I can do 11am PT. agenda: pinning policy, hotfix windows, rollback playbook.

kevin_t: 11am works. I want to add regression detection signals (perf + correctness) and who owns roll-forward.

nora_s: Heads-up: ROCm 5.7 had the tensor_core rounding diff; we'll need an explicit test in the eval harness.

sam_g: Marketplace release team: we require a 48h gating window after partner hotfixes for signed images. Can we standardize artifact names? e.g., `redwood-runtime:sha-driver-535_86`

maria_p: Good point @sam_g. Proposal: artifact tags include driver+cuda+rocm metadata, and an immutable release manifest we can share with partners.

alex_r: Proposed pin policy (draft):
```
- nvidia-driver: 535.86 (primary)
- cuda: 12.2.0
- rocm: 5.7-rc1 (optional per partner)
- fallback: driver-compat-legacy (compat layer)
```
Pin only major+minor, allow patch rollforward w/ automated smoke tests.

kevin_t: For hotfix lifecycle: emergency patch -> triage -> partner quick-fix image -> signed marketplace canary (10%) -> full roll. Need explicit SLOs: triage <2h, canary <4h, full roll <24h.

nora_s: For ROCm-specific regressions: include `eval/rocm-nightly` job that runs a subset of critical prompts and perf markers. If latency regresses >20% or token-accuracy drops >1% then block auto-roll.

sam_g: Marketplace constraints: signed images require a new attestation step after hotfix. That adds ~2h. We can parallelize smoke tests during attestation to shave time.

maria_p: Action items: @alex_r to update pin policy doc; @kevin_t to draft SLOs + rollback runbook; @nora_s to add ROCm eval job; @sam_g to list attestation steps. I'll set the partner call and share the doc link: http://go/internal/driver-pin-playbook (WIP).

deploy-bot: deploy-notice: canary rollout started for `redwood-runtime:sha-driver-535_86-20290321` -> 10% (region: us-west1).

kevin_t: Saw canary logs — one node showing OOM during long-seq test: `OOM at step 1024 on a100-80gb, kv-cache spike`. Investigating whether kernel/driver interaction.

alex_r: If it's driver-KA issue we need partner escalation. @maria_p can you open a vendor bridge with NV partner-eng and include kernel log + reproducer?

maria_p: On it. I'll ping partner-eng and schedule a quick war room if we can't cheaply mitigate.

sam_g: Noted. If we need rollback, marketplace: we can roll back signed image to previous `sha-20290318` with 30m turnaround if we pre-authorize. Recommend we pre-authorize a single rollback exec for emergencies.

nora_s: For reproducibility, saving the failing container with `--save-heapdump` and the exact seed + prompt will help partner debugging. I'll add a one-liner to the playbook.

maria_p: Great. I'll capture all AIs in the doc and circulate before the call. :thumbsup:

kevin_t: thanks — will also attach perf traces from our tracing service.

alex_r: LGTM. See you all on the call.
